## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Why does the current behaviour fall
short?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you want. Be specific about UI, data, and the coaching
experience it should enable.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you rejected them.

## Additional context

Mockups, related Garmin metrics, Anthropic API features, or links to similar
implementations.
